summary: The Guard and Reserve GI Bill Parity Act of 2025 expands eligibility for Post-9/11 educational assistance for members of the National Guard and reserve components of the Armed Forces by increasing the types of service activities that count toward eligibility.

affected_groups.effect: Can now count active duty, inactive-duty training, and annual training duty toward Post-9/11 educational assistance eligibility.
affected_groups.group: Members of the reserve components of the Armed Forces

affected_groups.effect: Can now count full-time National Guard duty or active duty toward Post-9/11 educational assistance eligibility.

key_provisions: Expands Post-9/11 GI Bill eligibility for reserve components to include active duty, inactive-duty training, and annual training duty.
Expands eligibility for National Guard members to include full-time National Guard duty or active duty.
Sets the effective date of the amendments to take effect one year after the date of enactment.
Applies the amendments retroactively to service performed on or after September 11, 2001.
Applies time limitation rules for using entitlement as if the amendments were enacted immediately after the Post-9/11 Veterans Educational Assistance Act of 2008.
missing_information: The exact number of service members who will become newly eligible for educational assistance.
The total federal cost associated with expanding these educational benefits.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Guard and Reserve GI Bill Parity Act of 2025 expands eligibility for Post-9/11 educational assistance for members of the National Guard and reserve components of the Armed Forces by increasing the types of service activities that count toward eligibility.
summary_detail.significance: This bill broadens federal educational benefits for part-time and reserve military personnel by recognizing a wider range of training and duty types dating back to September 11, 2001.

title: Guard and Reserve GI Bill Parity Act of 2025
